subject: RE: British Embassy Paris | Encord
text:
OFFICIAL

Hi Leo,
First of all, we are really happy to hear that Encord got through to round #2 for the Choose Paris Region event and we look forward to meeting you there.

Thanks for your time yesterday, it was great to understand Encord’s solution in more detail. I wanted to take the opportunity to follow up from our call with a re-cap and some next steps.

During our call we discussed:

Encord’s targets:

  *   You target Applied AI companies, enterprises running AI projects and research labs building AI models. Both scale-ups and corporates are relevant for Encord.
  *   Desired personas are AI teams and Data teams.
     *   Quick question: would personas working in open innovation teams be relevant for you?

Encord’s presence in the French market:

  *   Still developing this market, you have French speakers in your marketing team.
  *   Have organised 3/4 AI dinners in Paris.
  *   15/20 customers currently in France.
  *   Attended AI Pulse at Station F and Google event in Paris.
  *   Clients include: AXA, Gradium, Milvue, QT AI.

Next steps:

1)      Tech for Growth at the British Embassy in Paris: We will get in touch closer to the date regarding our “Tech for Growth” event between Vivatech and London Tech Week in June.

2)      Support with AI dinners: We would be happy to support the organisation of an AI dinner organised by Encord in Paris. We could help with your guestlist, send a representative from the embassy for a speaking slot and send a member of DBT France to facilitate introductions if needed.

3)      France Digitale is the tech lobbying group I mentioned in our call. I have checked and we do indeed have access to a discount for UK companies if this could be of interest for Encord.

  *   For context, France Digitale (FD) are the largest technology lobby group in France. Through our discount code, Encord would have the opportunity to become a member of France Digitale for €400 (instead of €500) and gain access to all of FD’s events programme (

I set up an S3 bucket with videos (arlo_videos/video.mp4) that your team connects to do the work. When the job is done your team uploads the annotation to another S3 bucket (arlo_annotations/annotation.json)

Attached is an example of the output json we would want, this is NOT final

subject: Re: Updated invitation: Encord & BotCo @ Tue Jan 27, 2026 10am - 10:30am (PST) (paril@bot.co)
text:
Nick, Moritz - Good to meet you just now. Sharing a bit more about our SOW
below. We'll look out for a proposal from you - let us know if any
questions.Scale of Engagement

   - Pilot phase: 10 full-time labelers (~20 daily hours labeled)
   - Near-term target (as soon as feasible): 100 full-time labelers (~200
   daily hours labeled)

Required Labeling Workflows

   1. Start with (provided by Bot.Co <http://bot.co/>) a video (MCAP) of a
   person or robot performing tasks and chunk them into discrete robot actions
      1. Example actions: approach and grasp the cup in the drying rack,
      carry the cup to the counter and place it on the coaster, grasp
the kitchen
      cabinet door, open the cabinet door, …
   2. Action Chunking: Place the boundaries when 1) gripper is closed,
   confirming a secure grasp around an object, 2) when the gripper releases an
   object
   3. Rating: Assess the quality of each action (or if there are mistakes
   within an action, sub-sequences of the action) and label them as:
   failed/mediocre/acceptable/excellent depending on the quality
      1. Example: If the person first picks up the cup, drops it, and the
      picks up the dropped object off the floor, you would identify
the drop and
      fail it, and label the initial pick and then the re-pick from
the floor as
      acceptable
      2. Note: Quality ratings incorporate a spectrum of attributes
      including: correct technique applied, fluidness of the motion, was the
      action successful, etc.
   4. Tagging: add relevant descriptive tags to the MCAP that explain why
   chunks were failed
      1. Example: jerky motion, poor grasping
   5. Captioning: Provide a clear and descriptive caption (in English) for
   each discrete action. These may be from scratch or is edited from a
   pre-generated caption from an LLM.
   6. [Future] model assisted segmentation for key objects in the scene
   (SAM2 for example with human editing). Usually we need to segment the
   object be

subject: Re: Encord/Skydio - 2nd Year Term Consolidation
text:
Kalpana - thank you!

Alyssa - great meeting you via email! Here are my comments and requested
updates:

1) The Misc section terms that supersede prior order forms is in conflict
with this statement "This Order Form is governed by the existing Terms and
Conditions between Encord and Skydio executed on January 24th, 2025." - can
you please address?
2) We want the US-based hours to roll cumulatively quarter-over-quarter
(e.g., from Q1 to Q2 and even into Q3) so please add a clarification about
this point as well
3) The Jan 2025 order form had a 98% quality standard that needs to be
added to this OF - updated language is below:

   - Encord shall make commercially reasonable efforts to ensure that the
   annotation teams meet the agreed-upon quality standards, which shall
   include a minimum accuracy level of 98% to be mutually agreed upon by the
   parties in writing.

4) We need to add the following for our data/security provisions:

   - Add this definition: "US-Based Labeling Services means labeling
   performed only by individuals physically located in the US at the time of
   access.”
   - Add this access restriction: "Client data associated with US-Based
   Labeling Services may not be accessed, viewed, or processed from outside
   the United States (including by Encord personnel and subcontractors)
   without Client’s prior written consent. No subcontractor may access Client
   data for US-Based Labeling Services unless (i) US-located, (ii) bound to
   confidentiality/data-protection terms at least as protective, and (iii)
   listed/approved in writing by Client.”
   - Add this data storage restriction: "Client data and deliverables will
   be stored and processed in US data centers only.”
   - Add this security restriction: "Encord shall provide the services with
   the following security protocols: a) incident notice within 48–72 hours, b)
   annual SOC2 report access under MNDA, and c) a minimum level of industry
   standard security controls."

Best regard
